quests.title: The Last Step of Testing

dialogue.t: Heya, Ginette! Did you get all the robots we found?
I did! Good work, you two.
Speaking of which, we made some new discoveries!
You did? Please tell me everything!

dialogue.sit: You and Paimon tell Ginette about what you witnessed not long ago.

dialogue.t: The behaviors you described... The robots seemed to like you very much, and thus sent you a message. An invitation to "play together."
Now I'm certain — my vision can only be realized through interactions between these robots. The more units we can retrieve, the closer we get to my original plan...
Now, they can already communicate with others. All we have to do is find the rest of the robots, and... Yes! I can see my creativity bearing fruit...!
Ah! Sorry, I'm getting a bit worked up... I'll still need your help for the rest. Here, I've marked out the next area on the map.
Then let's get going! Paimon's just as curious to see where this'll lead!

quests.description: Ginette’s idea seems to work, but she’s just one step away…
